title: A one-semester student received a full year’s federal loans

beats.text: A California art college awarded a full year of loans to a student enrolled for one semester.

visual.sub: The college originated a full academic year of loans

beats.text: The excess was $2,250 in subsidized loans and $4,000 in unsubsidized loans.
That was $6,250 in one of 40 files tested.
An earlier audit found two students each received $1,000 less in subsidized loans.
That kind of $1,000 underaward appeared again the following year.

visual.kicker: Earlier tests showed different award errors

beats.text: Pell grants showed different errors. One award was $537 too high.
In January 2024, the college trained staff and added a check for semester-only loans.

visual.kicker: The auditor discontinued the semester-loan recommendation

beats.text: The next auditors discontinued the recommendation.

visual.kicker: The auditor discontinued the semester-loan recommendation

beats.text: Their report did not establish a separate $6,250 repayment.

visual.kicker: The auditor discontinued the semester-loan recommendation
